reviews_verbatim.quote: I have to say I had the most peaceful welcoming visit. I trusted Marlen Diaz with my eyebrows and she's phenomenal, a perfectionist! She welcomed me at the door and made me feel comfortable throughout my appointment. She was very informative & answered all my questions. I'm in love with my brows !!

Amazing work! I'd been looking for a place to get my brows done for the last two years, then finally came across Mimi's work and instantly fell in love with what I saw! I booked my appointment asap and I'm glad I did My eyebrows turned out perfect and Mimi made sure of that. She's very meticulous when shaping them and made me comfortable throughout the process. I'm super happy with the results and looking forward getting my brows threaded at her shop in the near future. 10/10 highly recommend!

I took the 2 day 1:1 ombré powder brow training with her and it was the best experience I could've hoped for. The amount of information that she gives is unbelievable. She'll answer ANY questions you have even about business. Course goes beyond doing brows. You can tell that she really wants you to succeed. She's patient, sweet, knowledgeable. I recommend her to anyone who's starting their journey. You would get a great understanding of what being a PMU artist is all about. A bonus is working in that beautiful space she has. Overall 10/10.

Mimi is amazingggggggg! I am so thankful for Mimi. I was very fortunate to have her as my trainer. I had an amazing experience, she explained everything so well. I left her studio feeling very confident, I definitely would recommend her to anyone that is trying to become a permanent make up artist. She is very talented, Thank you so much Mimi. I will be returning to get my eyebrows done as well!
